sonnet.problem: The card says Joseph means 'Joseph's descendants'. Psalm 80:1 only says God 'leads Joseph like a flock' and doesn't say who Joseph stands for. The card explains the picture's meaning when the passage leaves it open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. This includes what a picture means. He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.

sonnet.problem: The card says Asaph 'turns from the vine to one person, the son of man'. Psalm 80:17 only says 'the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.' It doesn't say whether this man is a person apart from the vine, so the card takes a side on a debated phrase and decides who the figure is.

He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so. His jokes don't take a side on a debated phrase either.
